source_title: Fullmetal Alchemist Is Coming to Universal Studios
source_excerpt:

She prefers lore-heavy RPGs and walking sims and has only played Dragon Age: Inquisition 14 times. Her favorite Final Fantasy game is all of them.
The legendary anime series Fullmetal Alchemist is headed to Universal Studios Japan in 2027, along with original author Hiromu Arakawa's ongoing work Daemons of the Shadow Realm . The original Fullmetal Alchemist anime series first appeared at the theme park in Osaka in 2005, marking USJ's first collaboration with an anime series and paving the way for many more collabs to come. To celebrate 25 years of the Elric brothers in 2027, a huge celebration is on the way, and fans won't want to miss it.
In the early 2010s, Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry kicked off the 'Cool Japan' initiative, which aimed to fuel international interest in Japan by focusing on mediums like anime , video games, manga, and more. While the official project itself saw varying degrees of success before concluding this year, it led to a number of popular collabs and crossovers, and while the government's hand in Cool Japan has ceased, its goal lives on. Universal Studios Japan continues to use the moniker, and for Universal Cool Japan 2027, fans can look forward to some exciting additions to the park.
Fullmetal Alchemist Is Taking Over Universal Studios Japan in 2027
Universal Studios Japan has announced that both Fullmetal Alchemist and Daemons of the Shadow Realm will be featured throughout the park in 2027, with guests able to physically enter the worlds of both series via immersive experiences. While details are yet to come, the popular theme park is promising new attractions, merchandise, and themed food inspired by both of Arakawa's beloved series. In 2005, Fullmetal Alchemist was Universal Studios Japan's first collaboration with an anime series, appearing at the park during the "Fullmetal Alchemist Premium Tour." 2027 marks the 25th anniversary of what many still believe to be one of the best anime series of all time .
The storied legacy of Fullmetal Alchemist cannot be understated. While the original 2003 anime adaptation was met with incredible praise, it was 2009's Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood that went down in history to become the top-rated anime series on MAL for over a decade until being dethroned by Frieren: Beyond Journey's End in 2023. In 2021, the serialization of Arakawa's dark fantasy series Daemons of the Shadow Realm kicked off in Monthly Shonen Gangan magazine, with an anime adaptation beginning in April 2026. A second season was announced to be in production in September.
The Fullmetal Alchemist manga series has inspired more than just two anime adaptations. From OVAs, a live-action film, and light novels to a collectible card game, video games, and countless art books, Arakawa's work continues to be a phenomenon worldwide. At the time of writing, the manga has sold over 90 million copies worldwide , putting it on the same level as other mega hits like My Hero Academia , Captain Tsubasa , and Hunter x Hunter .
Universal Studios Japan has collaborated with a slew of anime and manga series over the last 20 years, including Sailor Moon , The Apothecary Diaries , Detective Conan , Frieren: Beyond Journey's End , One Piece , Spy x Family , My Hero Academia , Demon Slayer , Chainsaw Man , and more. Last year, the park also opened a 4-D Jujutsu Kaisen theater attraction, featuring an entirely new story for visitors to enjoy.
Both Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood and Daemons of the Shadow Realm can be streamed on Crunchyroll .
